server.name: DataPulse MY
server.description: Read-only access to DataPulse MY's Malaysian public dataset catalogue (389 datasets, 8-status health taxonomy, licence/attribution metadata).

auth.note: All tools are read-only; no auth needed. nginx enforces 1 request/second sustained with burst 20; verify_evidence additionally serializes and caches outbound checks.

tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Search DataPulse MY's 389 Malaysian public datasets by natural-language query. Filter by licence (e.g. 'CC BY 4.0', 'Open Government Licence (Malaysia)') or source ('OpenDOSM', 'data.gov.my', 'MET Malaysia', etc.). Returns ranked matches: id, title, source, licence, status, score. Use when an agent needs to find datasets covering a topic, by an agency, or under a specific licence.

query.description: Free-text search terms; natural language is allowed, e.g. 'inflation cpi'.

licence.description: Optional exact licence name or supported alias, e.g. 'CC BY 4.0'.

limit.description: Maximum ranked matches to return; integer from 1 to 50, e.g. 10.

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Return full detail for one dataset id, including its latest health status and last-verified timestamp, content_freshness_date, and freshness_signal_source (last_modified, content_parse, or none). Use to fetch the provenance/citation metadata for a dataset found via search_datasets and distinguish unknown-freshness from proven stale data.

dataset_id.description: Canonical dataset identifier, e.g. 'dosm_cpi_state'. See the registry catalogue for valid IDs.

tools.name: find_stale
tools.description: Return datasets whose status is aging, stale, or degraded, plus datasets missing from the latest health snapshot. Use when an agent needs to know which data has a freshness or schema-validity risk.

max_age_hours.description: Maximum acceptable age of the latest health check in whole hours; non-negative integer, e.g. 72.

tools.name: find_anomalies
tools.description: Return datasets flagged by the latest published anomaly detection, ranked by how far the observed update interval exceeds its threshold. Optionally require a minimum publish-reliability grade; includes pipeline-computed anomaly and reliability evidence so agents do not recompute it.

limit.description: Maximum ranked anomalies to return; integer from 1 to 200, e.g. 50.

mode.description: Optional exact detection mode; e.g. 'rolling_14d' or 'cadence_fallback'.

min_reliability.description: Optional minimum publish-reliability grade; e.g. 'C' keeps A, B, and C and excludes insufficient data.

tools.name: find_deteriorating
tools.description: Return datasets whose published freshness trend is deteriorating, ranked by staleness slope. Optionally require a minimum historical anomaly rate; includes pipeline-computed trend and reliability evidence so agents do not recompute it.

limit.description: Maximum ranked deteriorating datasets to return; integer from 1 to 200, e.g. 50.

min_anomaly_rate.description: Optional minimum percent of anomaly-evaluable history days, e.g. 25.0.

tools.name: find_recovering
tools.description: Return datasets whose published freshness trend is recovering, with the fastest staleness reductions first. Includes pipeline-computed trend and publish-reliability evidence.

limit.description: Maximum ranked recovering datasets to return; integer from 1 to 200, e.g. 50.

tools.name: find_unreliable
tools.description: Return datasets whose evaluated publish-reliability grade is at or below a threshold, with the worst grades and lowest on-time percentages first. Reliability measures timeliness of successful freshness observations, not uptime; sample days are included so agents can judge evidence depth.

limit.description: Maximum ranked unreliable datasets to return; integer from 1 to 200, e.g. 50.

at_or_below_grade.description: Inclusive reliability threshold; e.g. 'C' returns grades C, D, and F.

tools.name: find_schema_drift
tools.description: Return datasets with published structural or record-count drift evidence, ranked with structural changes first. Optionally require a minimum number of structural transitions; includes pipeline-computed evidence so agents do not infer drift from freshness alone.

limit.description: Maximum ranked drift results to return; integer from 1 to 200, e.g. 50.

min_change_count.description: Minimum structural fingerprint or column-count transitions; integer from 0 to 100, e.g. 1.

tools.name: check_reconciliation
tools.description: Return the published cross-source reconciliation group for a dataset name or id, including per-member counts, dates, statuses, tolerances, and contextual deltas. A discrepancy requires human review and does not prove either source is wrong.

dataset_name.description: Dataset id or name to reconcile, e.g. 'interestrates' or 'Monthly Interest Rates'.

tools.name: get_provenance
tools.description: Return citation-ready provenance metadata for the listed dataset ids, plus compact pipeline-published evidence receipts: row probe time, HTTP status, request URL, access dependency, freshness source, content date, record count, shape fingerprint, anomaly flag, and status. Use when an agent must cite data and show the evidence behind the trust claim without recomputing it.

dataset_ids.description: JSON array of 1 to 50 canonical dataset IDs, e.g. ['fuelprice', 'pricecatcher'].

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.description: Return the complete pipeline-published evidence receipt for one dataset id, including probe time, transport, access dependency, freshness, record-count, shape, tolerance, status, and anomaly fields. Use for a deep audit, e.g. get_evidence('fuelprice'); values are presented without MCP-side recomputation.

dataset_id.description: Canonical dataset identifier for a deep receipt, e.g. 'fuelprice'.

tools.name: verify_evidence
tools.description: Perform a rate-limited live streamed GET for one direct-access dataset and compare transport receipts with the latest published evidence, e.g. verify_evidence('fuelprice'). Content dates, row counts, and shape fingerprints remain pipeline-only and are explicitly reported as unverified; results are ephemeral and never update health artifacts.

dataset_id.description: Canonical direct-access dataset identifier to re-fetch, e.g. 'fuelprice'.

tools.name: find_by_licence
tools.description: Return all datasets with the given licence, summarised. Use to enumerate what's available under a specific licence for compliance/reuse scoping.

licence.description: Exact licence name or supported alias, e.g. 'Creative Commons Attribution 4.0'.

resources.name: Dataset index
resources.description: Lightweight list of all 389 datasets with namespace. Read this first.

resources.name: Anomaly summary
resources.description: Datasets flagged by the latest published anomaly detection, ranked by severity with pipeline-computed evidence.

resources.name: Trend summary
resources.description: Published per-dataset freshness trends and publish-reliability evidence, including methodology and aggregate counts.

resources.name: Reliability summary
resources.description: Counts of datasets by evaluated publish-reliability grade, computed from the published trend artifact.

resources.name: Drift summary
resources.description: Published per-dataset schema and record-count drift evidence, including methodology and aggregate verdict counts.

resources.name: Reconciliation summary
resources.description: Published cross-source reconciliation groups with pairwise count, date, status, tolerance, and verdict evidence.

resources.name: Licence summary
resources.description: Counts of datasets by licence, computed from the current manifest.

resources.name: Full manifest entry
resources.description: Full schema, source URL, attribution, and current health for one dataset.

rate_limits.note: Cloudflare Tunnel free tier; no per-IP limit published. Be a good citizen.
